examples: The gate is made of iron.
Iron is a metal.
The bridge is iron.

more.def: A hard, strong metal that is used to make tools, nails and many other things.
examples: The fence is made of iron.
Iron rusts when it gets wet.
A magnet sticks to iron.

easy.def: A tool that you heat to make clothes smooth.
examples: Dad used an iron on the shirt.
The iron is hot.
Be careful with the iron.

more.def: A flat, heated tool used to press wrinkles out of clothes.
examples: Dad used an iron to smooth the wrinkles in his shirt.
The iron is very hot, so do not touch it.
Mom ironed the shirt with a steam iron.

easy.def: Not even or not in a regular way.
examples: The path is irregular.
The shape was irregular.
She had irregular sleep.

more.def: Not smooth, even or regular in shape or pattern, or not following the usual rule.
examples: The coastline has an irregular shape with many bays and points.
The word "went" is an irregular verb because it does not end in -ed.
The old clock ticked at irregular times.

easy.def: So good that you cannot say no.
examples: The warm cookies were irresistible.
That puppy is irresistible.
The pool looked irresistible.

more.def: So tempting or so charming that you cannot stop yourself from wanting it.
examples: The smell of fresh pancakes was irresistible, so we all got out of bed.
The baby's giggle was irresistible and made everyone laugh too.
On such a hot day, the cool lake looked irresistible.

easy.def: Not careful about what you should do.
examples: It is irresponsible to leave the gate open.
He was irresponsible with his toys.
That was an irresponsible thing to do.

more.def: Not acting in a careful or sensible way, so that you let others down.
examples: It was irresponsible of him to leave the stove on.
Leaving a campfire burning is irresponsible and could hurt the forest.
The irresponsible driver forgot to check his mirrors before turning.

easy.def: To bother someone or make something sore.
examples: The noise irritates me.
The wool irritates my skin.
Smoke irritates my eyes.

more.def: To make someone annoyed, or to make part of the body red, itchy or sore.
examples: The loud tapping began to irritate everyone in the quiet room.
Wool can irritate sensitive skin and make it itchy.
The cold wind irritated her eyes.
The noise is irritating.
An irritating buzz.
It is irritating.

more.def: Annoying, so that it makes you feel bothered or upset.
examples: The irritating buzz of the fly kept me awake.
It was irritating to wait so long.
The tag on my shirt was irritating.
